verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (eyebrow, headline, body, CTA) on a clean left edge. Its flaws: the CTA pill is oversized and nearly full-width, so it competes with the headline; it sits too tight under the body copy; and the bottle crowds the bottom edge. B moves the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below the body copy, which breaks the hierarchy. It also leaves the top band empty, strands 'sparkling.' on its own line, and mixes left-aligned text with a centred bottle and CTA, so there's no shared axis.
